verdict.rationale: Adyen's offline-payment docs say merchants can keep taking point-of-sale payments during a temporary internet outage once offline payments are enabled. The marketing page adds that terminals 'stay up and running, even when the internet is down.' This covers the core of the story, but the evidence does not describe the store-and-forward mechanics, and the feature must be enabled first. missing for 10: explicit documentation of how offline transactions are stored and forwarded when connectivity returns, limits and risk controls on offline transactions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
